name: com.paros-summer/paros-summer-travellers
title: Paros Summer Travellers
description: Vehicle rental on Paros, Greece: prices, availability and booking requests a person confirms.

tools.name: today
tools.description: Return today's date in the business timezone (Europe/Athens) as YYYY-MM-DD plus the weekday. Use it to resolve relative dates like 'this weekend' or 'next Monday'.

tools.name: list_vehicle_types
tools.description: List the vehicle types the company rents: slug, label (the market name) and prices in €. `daily_rate` is the BASE rate, not the price of any date: `daily_rate_seasons` names the season(s) it equals and `daily_rate_note` explains it. `season_rates` gives each upcoming season's daily rate and dates, and `from_daily_rate` / `from_season` the lowest of them — use it for a 'from €X a day' starting price. For the price of real dates ALWAYS call quote_price. Does NOT return how many vehicles exist — fleet size is confidential and unavailable. The Jeep Wrangler Rubicon 4xe is not listed: it is rented on request only, with no online price.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Check whether a vehicle type can be rented for a pickup→return window. Returns a coarse level only: 'available', 'limited' (book soon), or 'unavailable'. It does NOT return how many vehicles are free — that is confidential. ALWAYS call this before telling a visitor a vehicle is or isn't available on specific dates; never guess. A generic vehicle_type that fits several types (car, scooter, moped, 125cc, kia, cfmoto) checks every one of them: available = at least one is, and matched_types / available_types say which. A vehicle_type it does not recognise is an ERROR listing the accepted values — it never means 'unavailable'. The Jeep Wrangler Rubicon 4xe (jeep, wrangler) is request only, with no online availability: the tool says so.

vehicle_type.description: A slug from list_vehicle_types (any case: Quad, Buggy, FIAT PANDA, Auto-Car, Jeep-SUV, Scooter50, Scooter125, PREMIUM 125CC, Jeep-Wrangler), its label, or a common English or Greek word: atv / quad / quad bike / γουρούνα / τετράτροχο → Quad; buggy → Buggy; panda → FIAT PANDA; picanto → Auto-Car (KIA PICANTO); sportage → Jeep-SUV (KIA SPORTAGE TURBO); 50cc → Scooter50; jet14 → PREMIUM 125CC (SYM Jet14 125); piaggio / fiddle / symphony sr 125 → Scooter125. Generic words (car, scooter, moped, 125cc, kia, cfmoto) cover every matching type.

tools.name: quote_price
tools.description: Compute an exact price quote for the visitor's own hypothetical rental: vehicle_type, start_date, end_date, optional insurance_type ('basic'|'extra'). Returns daily rate, total days, vehicle subtotal, insurance subtotal and total (EUR). ALWAYS use this for a date-specific price rather than the indicative prices in your knowledge base. A generic vehicle_type that fits several types (car, scooter, moped, 125cc, kia, cfmoto) does not pick one: the result has choose_one=true and `options` — a full quote per matching type, cheapest first — and no single total; ask the visitor which one. An unrecognised vehicle_type is an error listing the accepted values. The Jeep Wrangler Rubicon 4xe is request only, with no online price: never quote another vehicle's price for it.

vehicle_type.description: A slug from list_vehicle_types (any case: Quad, Buggy, FIAT PANDA, Auto-Car, Jeep-SUV, Scooter50, Scooter125, PREMIUM 125CC, Jeep-Wrangler), its label, or a common English or Greek word: atv / quad / quad bike / γουρούνα / τετράτροχο → Quad; buggy → Buggy; panda → FIAT PANDA; picanto → Auto-Car (KIA PICANTO); sportage → Jeep-SUV (KIA SPORTAGE TURBO); 50cc → Scooter50; jet14 → PREMIUM 125CC (SYM Jet14 125); piaggio / fiddle / symphony sr 125 → Scooter125. Generic words (car, scooter, moped, 125cc, kia, cfmoto) cover every matching type.

tools.name: create_booking_request
tools.description: Submit a BOOKING REQUEST for the visitor once you have gathered ALL of: vehicle_type, start_date, end_date, start_time, return_time, full_name, email, phone, country (optional: insurance_type). This does NOT confirm or charge anything — it creates a pending request our team reviews and confirms. The driver's licence is checked at pickup; there is no security deposit, and we may ask a small advance payment, the rest paid at pickup. Call it ONLY after the visitor has explicitly given every required field and asked to book/request. Do not invent any field. The price is re-computed server-side. Returns a request_id and status.

vehicle_type.description: One specific vehicle type: a slug from list_vehicle_types (any case), its label, or a word for exactly one type (atv / quad / quad bike / γουρούνα / τετράτροχο → Quad; buggy → Buggy; panda → FIAT PANDA; picanto → Auto-Car (KIA PICANTO); sportage → Jeep-SUV (KIA SPORTAGE TURBO); 50cc → Scooter50; jet14 → PREMIUM 125CC (SYM Jet14 125); piaggio / fiddle / symphony sr 125 → Scooter125). A generic word that fits several types (car, scooter, moped, 125cc, kia, cfmoto) is refused with the options — ask the visitor which one. The Jeep Wrangler Rubicon 4xe is request only and cannot be submitted here.

locale.description: Optional. The visitor's language for their confirmation email (defaults to English). Set it to the language you are speaking with the visitor.

tools.name: prepare_booking_link
tools.description: Build a prefilled booking-page URL the traveller opens to review and submit. Does NOT submit, reserve or charge anything — it only returns a link. With vehicle_type + start_date + end_date present, the page skips the date + vehicle steps (they arrive prefilled) and opens on the traveller-details step. NEVER include a name, email or phone — the traveller types those in, then reviews and submits. This is the sanctioned way to hand a ready-to-submit booking to a human.

vehicle_type.description: Fleet slug from list_vehicle_types (e.g. Quad), a website category (car|scooter|atv|buggy), or a common English or Greek word: atv / quad / quad bike / γουρούνα / τετράτροχο → Quad; buggy → Buggy; panda → FIAT PANDA; picanto → Auto-Car (KIA PICANTO); sportage → Jeep-SUV (KIA SPORTAGE TURBO); 50cc → Scooter50; jet14 → PREMIUM 125CC (SYM Jet14 125); piaggio / fiddle / symphony sr 125 → Scooter125. Generic words (car, scooter, moped) open that category for the traveller to pick the model. The Jeep Wrangler Rubicon 4xe is request only.

vehicle.description: Optional website vehicle page slug (e.g. fiat-panda). Usually leave it out: it is filled in when vehicle_type names one model.

pickup_location.description: Optional. naousa=our office, port=Paros Port (Parikia), hotel-*=hotel delivery.

tools.name: get_vehicle_details
tools.description: Who may drive each vehicle type and what it is: minimum driver age, the driving-licence category it needs, how long the licence must be held, the International Driving Permit rule, transmission, engine size (scooters), seats where we state them, helmets, child seats, luggage, the minimum rental (cars: 2 days), what to bring to pickup and the excess with the optional Extra insurance. ALWAYS use this before telling a traveller they can or cannot drive a vehicle with their licence or age. No prices (use quote_price) and no availability (use check_availability). Leave vehicle_type out to get every vehicle type. A field that is missing is not stated: never guess it; the traveller can ask us on WhatsApp +30 694 607 5400.

vehicle_type.description: Optional. A slug from list_vehicle_types (any case), its label, a category (car|scooter|atv|buggy) or a common English or Greek word: atv / quad / quad bike / γουρούνα / τετράτροχο → Quad; buggy → Buggy; panda → FIAT PANDA; picanto → Auto-Car (KIA PICANTO); sportage → Jeep-SUV (KIA SPORTAGE TURBO); 50cc → Scooter50; jet14 → PREMIUM 125CC (SYM Jet14 125); piaggio / fiddle / symphony sr 125 → Scooter125. Generic words (car, scooter) return every matching type. The Jeep Wrangler Rubicon 4xe is included (request only). Leave it out for all vehicle types.
